review: DAENEM Staff Portal statutory Payroll configuration review

findings.summary: Truthy non-boolean JSON values such as the string false could silently enable statutory Payroll settings.
findings.correction: Enablement fields now accept only explicit boolean or 0/1 values, normalize them once, and use the normalized values for persistence, activation checks, and audit evidence.

findings.summary: Omitting mode defaulted a statutory profile mutation to draft and could unintentionally change an existing profile.
findings.correction: Statutory saves now require an explicit valid draft, active, or paused mode.

findings.summary: PAYE rule-version and review-note fields were unbounded at the API trust boundary.
findings.correction: The Worker now enforces a 120-character rule-version limit and a 2,000-character review-note limit before persistence.

reviewer.result: PASS for the bounded statutory Payroll configuration change; authenticated rendered V45 browser acceptance remains pending because the retained public Sites project has no non-production preview URL.
